item.title: Version 2.7.6
item.description:
• Fixed: Claude Code native tab no longer gets stuck on "Puzzling…" after long sessions — a wedged Node agent bridge is detected via a heartbeat watchdog and restarted automatically, and the Node process is proactively recycled every 25 idle turns.
  • Fixed: Large file writes no longer get killed with "Claude stopped responding" mid-generation — the stall watchdogs now tolerate long tool-input generation (up to 10 min) instead of the old 90s ceiling that deterministically aborted big Write commands.
  • Fixed: A frozen app now terminates on Quit instead of hanging until Force Quit — the main-thread watchdog force-exits after 15s of continuous freeze (3s once Quit was requested).
  • Improved: Internal telemetry — bridge watchdog now emits notice-level breadcrumbs visible in the unified log without requiring sudo log config, so future bridge issues are easier to diagnose from Console.

item.title: Version 2.7.5
item.description:
• Fixed: Claude Code web tab's "next steps" suggestions no longer cancel an active AI-panel conversation.
  • Improved: Next-steps suggestions now consider tool activity (files edited, commands run, failures) and no longer re-propose completed work.

item.title: Version 2.7.4
item.description:
• Added real Effort controls to Claude Code Native and Web.
  • Improved responsive activity sidebar sizing across Mac displays.
